name: Minnesota Open 2011
information: Registration closes on June 19th at 11:59 PM.  After that, you will be limited to only certain events (3x3, 2x2, Magics, and Pyraminx).  If you pay the fees online, the cost will be $4 for the first event, and $1 for each additional event.  If you pay the day of the competition, the cost is $5 for the first event, and $2 for each additional event (please have exact change).
